note: Russell 2000 has 2000 names with annual rebalances. A reliable cap-weighted aggregate requires ~200+ constituents to cover meaningful index weight. agents/fundamentals_carry.py deliberately excludes IWM from the EDGAR XBRL aggregation path (see EQUITY_INDICES_AGGREGATABLE) so the equity-fundamentals factors stay at zero rather than serve a 5%-coverage signal that the LLM would over-weight.
